key.name: ring-radius
key.description: Radius of the highlight ring, in pixels.

key.name: ring-color
key.description: Hex color of the highlight ring, e.g. #ffffff.

key.name: sensitivity
key.description: How many back-and-forth reversals of turning the shake must add up to. Lower triggers more easily.

key.name: shake-window
key.description: How much of the recent pointer track counts toward a shake, in milliseconds.

key.name: min-travel
key.description: Distance the pointer must cover between two consecutive samples, in pixels. This is what separates a shake from slow scribbling.

key.name: cooldown
key.description: Quiet period after a trigger before another shake can fire, in milliseconds.

key.name: poll-interval
key.description: How often the pointer position is sampled, in milliseconds.
